Voluntary participation from landowners ensures they receive both financial and technical aid to cultivate these new grasslands.
title: $8M plan to return 7,500 acres of South Dakota cropland to grassland

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Accenture highlights that banks like JPMorgan Chase and Charles Schwab are restricting AI agents from their systems. Michael Abbott, Accenture's global banking lead, suggests that this strategy may negatively impact customer relationships. Research indicates a significant percentage of consumers are open to integrating AI assistants in banking. Institutions should focus on developing secure mechanisms for AI interactions rather than blocking access completely.
title: As banks block AI agents, Accenture warns of lost customers

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A troubling situation has emerged at Milton Evergreen Cemetery in Ontario, where numerous families have reported stolen items from gravesites. Following an inquiry, a 57-year-old woman has been arrested in connection with these thefts. Police have managed to recover sentimental objects, such as lanterns and plants, and are actively contacting families who may still be unaware of the losses. As the investigation broadens, additional charges against the suspect are likely.
title: Woman, 57, charged over alleged thefts from graves at Milton cemetery

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: In 1610, the revolutionary work of Galileo Galilei, titled Sidereus Nuncius, brought to light the moons orbiting Jupiter, challenging the traditional view of astronomy. This groundbreaking revelation incited controversy, notably with Francesco Sizzi, who dismissed these lunar discoveries as mere optical deceptions. Recently, a rare edition of Galileo's masterpiece fetched an astonishing Rs 2.07 crore, underscoring the enduring impact of his innovations amidst the scientific skepticism of his era.
title: Galileo's 1610 Jupiter moons proof and rival's rebuttal sell for Rs 2.07 cr

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Inspired by Rahul Gandhi': BJP targets AISA's Neha Bora over 'Brahmanvaad' remarks

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: New Zealand has witnessed two defining milestones in Shubman Gill's early career. After an India U-19 World Cup title and ODI debut, he hits these shores as leader of men. Seven years after being handed the cap by MS Dhoni, he returns as India's captain, carrying the expectations of a billion fans and the responsibility of building a team for the 2027 World Cup.
title: From boy wonder to leader: Shubman Gill returns to the land of his firsts

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Stock market rally today: At 1:30 PM, Nifty50 was trading at 23,724.00, up 283 points or 1.21%. BSE Sensex was at 76,722.16, up 1,029 points or 1.36%. Bhuvneshwar, who returned after four years, struggled during the T20I series against New Zealand. He recorded just one wicket and an economy rate of 11.50 in four matches. Ashwin believes Mohammad Shami might now have a stronger case for a comeback.

author: PRIYANGI AGARWAL
description: Green crackers are designed to produce less air and noise pollution compared to conventional fireworks. They achieve significant reductions in particulate matter and gaseous emissions. Although they are less harmful, studies indicate they still emit dangerous ultrafine particles. Various firecracker restrictions have been imposed in Delhi over the years, yet many have been frequently ignored. Recent pollution readings demonstrate ongoing challenges related to firecracker use during festivals.
title: Green crackers vs conventional fireworks: Are they really safe for Diwali?

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A tragic incident occurred in Ahmedabad when a speeding car struck a family selling sofa covers. Two individuals, a mother and her teenage son, were killed in the accident. The driver, identified as Viral Savjibhai Chaudhary, was allegedly intoxicated and in custody. Police recovered several bottles of beer from his vehicle, leading to separate complaints. Local residents have expressed concerns regarding frequent speeding incidents in the area.
title: ‘6 beer bottles, late-night race’: Speeding Fortuner kills mother, son selling sofa covers

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The marshmallow test has provided valuable insights into how children navigate decision-making related to delayed rewards. Emerging research indicates that a child's potential to wait is shaped by their trust in those around them, particularly caregivers. Key aspects like family dynamics and home surroundings critically affect self-regulation skills. Scholars stress the need for secure and reliable environments to help children develop self-control.
title: Failing marshmallow test may reflect home life, not willpower: Psychology

title: Jeff Bezos' $1 million grant backs farming jobs for formerly incarcerated Atlanta youth

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Scientists have discovered genetic links between eastern and western European populations after analysing DNA from a woman who lived around 30,000 years ago in southwestern France. The study, led by the University of Vienna, challenges earlier assumptions that Ice Age populations remained largely isolated. Researchers also recovered ancient human DNA from cave sediments in Spain, revealing long-term population continuity and connections across Europe.
title: 30,000-year-old French burial reveals Ice Age Europeans weren't isolated

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 26-year-old Australian fisherman, Matthew Maurice, won A$1 million after catching an 80cm red-tagged barramundi during a fishing trip with his younger brother in the Northern Territory. The Thursday catch made him only the second person to win the top prize in the Million Dollar Fish competition's 12-year history. Maurice plans to use the money to buy a house and clear outstanding payments.
title: Australian fisherman, 26, wins A$1M with tagged 80cm barramundi catch

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: India and the United States have commenced the fifth edition of Exercise Tiger Triumph in Visakhapatnam. This exercise aims to improve interoperability for humanitarian assistance and disaster response between the armed forces. The focus has expanded to include space, cyber, and command and control in the training sessions. High-level military engagements continue to strengthen the defense relationship between both nations.
title: Beyond disaster relief: India-US Tiger Triumph exercise brings cyber, space into focus

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Inmates at the Franklin County Corrections Center have been drawing portraits of shelter dogs. Their artwork has resulted in higher adoption rates, helping many dogs find homes. This initiative allows inmates to contribute positively to the community while creating a connection with potential adopters. The portraits humanize the dogs, making them more relatable to visitors. Such simple actions have led to transformative impacts for both dogs and incarcerated individuals.

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Kimi Antonelli went from struggling with the pressure of replacing Lewis Hamilton at Mercedes to becoming Formula 1's youngest-ever World Champion in just his second season. After a difficult rookie campaign in 2025, the Italian dominated 2026 with nine victories and 16 podiums, breaking Sebastian Vettel's record and ending Italy's 73-year wait for a Formula 1 world champion.

description: India's fielding will face an early test at Auckland's Eden Park, where unfamiliar dimensions and tricky angles demand quick adaptation. With 27 catches dropped in their last 18 ODIs, the focus is on sharpening ground fielding and improving catching efficiency ahead of the New Zealand series.

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Indian Railways is working towards starting trial runs of the B28 train on the 100-km Surat-Vapi stretch of the Ahmedabad-Mumbai High Speed Rail corridor by May-June 2027. Commercial services on this section are expected to commence in August 2027. What will be special about India’s first bullet train? What are the features that passengers can look forward to? We take a look:
title: India's 1st bullet train: 280 kmph speed, 557 passengers, 8 coaches; top 20 features

author: TNN
description: The Bombay high court found the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's removal of Dia Mirza's video unfortunate and requested its restoration. This action followed objections from BJP's Mumbai unit chief Ameet Satam, linking the video to anti-India sentiments. Mirza's video urged citizens to avoid firecrackers and pollution during Diwali celebrations. Despite the removal, other celebrity campaign videos were retained on BMC's social media accounts.
title: Dia Mirza Diwali appeal row: Deeply pained, says HC; asks BMC to re-upload video

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: VS Rathanvel's journey to becoming India's 99th Grandmaster took an unexpected turn after FIDE did not recognise his initial rating achievement. Despite completing his norms in 2022, the Coimbatore player had to cross the 2500 rating mark again. After setbacks, pressure and uncertainty, he finally secured the required rating in Hungary, ending a four-year wait with relief rather than celebration.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Sameer Nehra triumphantly completed the Adi Kailash Parikrama Run, conquering a challenging 70 kilometers in a remarkable 12 hours and 17 minutes. Enduring grueling conditions, he not only tested his physical limits but also discovered a profound spiritual connection with Lord Shiv Ji. Though tempted to give up amidst exhaustion, his resolve saw him through.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a significant security breach, Google has cut ties with Videostrong Co after discovering a malicious backdoor integrated into over 1.3 million devices. This vulnerability enabled hackers to control devices remotely, resulting in ad fraud and the theft of sensitive information. Primarily impacting Android TV set-top boxes and various IoT products, the malware's installation during device setup posed detection challenges.
title: Google Chinese company, partner for Android devices, secretly turned 1.3 million devices into 'spy gadgets'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Norman, Oklahoma has unveiled a captivating new public sculpture named Hazmatt, crafted from recycled dumpsters. This striking giant robot, funded by surplus construction funds totaling slightly over $14,000, is strategically located at the city’s Household Hazardous Waste Facility. Hazmatt serves to inspire the community, highlighting the importance of responsible waste management and showcasing the potential for creative reuse of discarded materials.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Her Honor Mentoring began with a modest gathering of girls two decades ago and has since flourished remarkably. This program matches high school seniors with dedicated mentors, guiding them through educational and career paths. Participants acquire vital skills, including financial literacy, that prepare them for both college and professional futures while fostering nurturing relationships that empower young women to chase their dreams.
title: Judge Judy's 2006 mentoring program with 9 girls now serves 1,500 women

description: Tusshar Kapoor received an extortion call demanding Rs 5 crore from someone posing as a gang member. The Mumbai Crime Branch conducted a preliminary investigation into the threatening call received by the actor. Their technical team analyzed the audio and found no matching voice with official samples. Police believe the impersonator used the gang's name to instill fear and extort money.

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Hardik Pandya has not played for the Indian team since the 2026 T20 World Cup final. He has missed several international matches due to fitness concerns, including tours of Ireland and England. Captain Shubman Gill emphasized Pandya's importance for strengthening India's batting order. The team management is in regular contact with Pandya about his fitness and recovery plans.
title: 'Hopefully he plays some domestic': Shubman Gill gives update on Hardik Pandya

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Matthew Shroder and Mackenzie Fotsch are currently embroiled in legal disputes regarding a jointly owned property in Sausalito. After achieving a partial victory in a motion to strike, Shroder sought $90,010 in attorney fees and the court awarded him $66,192.50. This amount includes $40,887.50 for anti-SLAPP proceedings and $21,700 for the fee application, yet does not resolve their ongoing property conflict.

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: Lovish Chadha, a frustrated customer, ordered a graphics card from Amazon but was shocked to find only an empty box upon delivery. After receiving no help from customer service, he escalated the issue by filing a complaint with the consumer commission. The commission ruled that both the seller and Amazon were accountable, ordering a full refund plus compensation for the distress and legal fees incurred, with a 45-day compliance timeframe.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Hyderabad's Lumbini Park features a new water-recycling public toilet that has begun operations. The facility uses a closed-loop water infrastructure capable of treating and reusing water on-site. Developed by ReFlow and backed by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, this initiative reduces the need for traditional sewage systems. Installed with solar power, the unit exemplifies innovative sanitation solutions for urban water management.

Such recognition of our interconnectedness and the act of thanking others nurture compassion, reduce stress, and enhance our happiness, ultimately leading to a richer, more fulfilled experience of life.

description: Toddlers exhibit an evolving grasp of sharing as they interact with toys and their peers. While it’s common for them to tease or reclaim items, these actions are part of their learning journey. Studies show that sharing skills typically mature between 18 to 24 months. To nurture these skills, parents should encourage enjoyable social activities without forcing them to share.

Oceanographers seized this unexpected incident as a unique opportunity to study ocean currents and their migration patterns. Through collaboration with beachcombers and intricate simulations, they gathered crucial data, unveiling new insights on global ocean connectivity. Despite the degradation of most toys over time, their remarkable journey still aids scientists in examining marine debris.

With plans to introduce yoga practices to IT professionals for better health, his ambitious goal is to write 100 books while nurturing the community's well-being.

description: Delhi police personnel protested the transfer of ACP Manasvi Vashistha following a confrontation with lawyers at Shahdara police station. Vashistha's suspension came after hundreds gathered to express their discontent at police headquarters. A meeting with the police commissioner resulted in promises of addressing the genuine grievances raised by officers.

description: Payal Zambre Patil was found hanging in a flat in Mukund Nagar following conflicts with her mother-in-law. Her husband and four in-laws were arrested after allegations of harassment and demands for gold emerged. Payal had sent worrying messages before her death, indicating her mother-in-law would be responsible for any harm. Her family claimed she was pressured to give birth to a male child, causing further distress.

The proposed sale has also raised questions over the Duchy’s claimed exemption from capital gains tax.

This situation continues to strain global energy supplies, particularly through the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

As the storm weakens into a deep depression by midnight, residents in low-lying areas are urged to brace for potential flooding.

description: Russian forces struck a school being used as a humanitarian aid distribution centre in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, killing at least 26 people, with around 20 others missing. description: Jeff Bezos’ Day 1 Families Fund awarded Mary’s Place $5 million in 2020 to support families experiencing homelessness. description: Sourabh Chandrakar has been extradited from Oman and is a key figure in a significant illegal betting case. With her recent appointment to the new Vande Bharat Sleeper Express, she symbolizes the increasing involvement of women in the railway sector. This service caters to overnight travelers between Varanasi and New Delhi, marking a pivotal shift in a profession historically dominated by men.

description: A fire occurred at Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited Visakh Refinery during the night, alarming nearby residents. Flames erupted near a Ruf Pitch Oil tank, capturing the attention of passing commuters. Many people recorded videos of the incident, which spread rapidly on social media platforms. HPCL sources reported that there were no injuries or casualties stemming from the event. An investigation is ongoing to determine the cause of the fire.

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: The Indian Navy successfully rescued all 20 crew members from the hijacked fishing vessel Azini off Somalia. description: Delhi's air quality index has reached hazardous levels, with several areas reporting severe pollution rates. Areas such as Rohini, Punjabi Bagh, and Bawana recorded alarming AQI figures above 400. Authorities have initiated Stage-II of the Graded Response Action Plan to combat the worsening air quality in the NCR. Enforcement measures will include daily mechanical sweeping and water sprinkling on heavy-traffic roads.

description: The US Supreme Court has made a pivotal decision by rejecting an emergency appeal from the Trump administration concerning California ballots ahead of the midterm elections. California officials argued that the federal government's allegations lacked trustworthiness, posing a risk to legitimate voters' rights. The courts have repeatedly dismissed the administration's attempts to influence California's electoral process.
title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump's push to isolate 20,000 California ballots over citizenship claims

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Jason Dozier initiated a fundraising campaign in 2020, which led to the creation of the Housing Stability Fund. This programme has provided financial assistance to over 5,500 families facing housing insecurity in the Atlanta area. By streamlining processes and collaborating with landlords, the programme aims to prevent evictions and court backlogs. Follow-up surveys indicate that a majority of recipients remain in stable housing a year later.
title: Atlanta landlord's $50K fundraiser grows to $16.5M, saves 5,500 families

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Post Oak Ridge has officially opened, marking Texas' latest state park. Spanning over 3,000 acres, it features two hiking trails along four miles of scenic routes. Plans for future camping facilities and river access are on track for completion by 2029. Input from the community has been vital in guiding the park's development, as part of a larger effort to expand public outdoor spaces across Texas.
title: Texas opens 3,000-acre state park along Colorado River with $1bn fund

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After the heartbreaking passing of their bulldog, Howard and Beth Stern channeled their sorrow into meaningful change by founding Bianca's Furry Friends Feline Adoption Center, part of North Shore Animal League America. This center improves the conditions for cats waiting for adoption and boosts rescue capabilities. With over 2,000 cats fostered since 2013, Beth's dedicated efforts have played a crucial role in spotlighting the importance of adopting shelter animals nationwide.
title: Howards Sterns honor late dog Bianca with cat adoption center, 2,000 rescues

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The year 2026 revealed the public's fascination with various prominent personalities through trending Google searches. Kylie Jenner's memorable runway moments sparked widespread dialogue, cementing her family's media dominance. Meanwhile, Lindsay Clancy's trial shed light on critical postpartum mental health issues. Nicole Kidman's virality underscored her timeless appeal, while fans united in sorrow over the passing of Hayden Panettiere and Dolly Parton.
title: Google's most searched people of 2026 list features surprising names

author: RASHMI DROLIA
description: Sourabh Chandrakar, who previously operated a juice shop, transformed into an online betting syndicate head. He allegedly managed Mahadev Online Book, an illegal betting empire that expanded internationally. Following his extravagant wedding costing Rs 200 crore, investigators intensified scrutiny of his operations. After being located in Oman, he was extradited to India for legal proceedings. His case raises significant questions about money laundering and political involvement in Chhattisgarh.
title: From juice vendor to 200-crore Dubai wedding: Rise & fall of Mahadev betting boss

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Howard University's golf program reached new heights when both men's and women's teams won their conference championships. The women's team claimed its first-ever Northeast Conference title in April 2026. Just days later, the men's team secured its third consecutive NEC championship victory. The successes highlighted the growth of the program, supported by NBA star Stephen Curry's funding.
title: Stephen Curry-backed Howard golf teams win historic titles in 2026

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Florida man preparing to sell his home, which he estimates is worth $500,000, discovered a disputed quitclaim deed listing $10 in consideration and allegedly affecting his ownership stake. His former wife, Sharon Joy Barnett, faces a first-degree felony identity-fraud charge. The former couple purchased the Margate property for approximately $265,000 in 2006.
title: Florida man selling $500K home finds $10 deed; ex-wife charged with felony
